liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Saint Of Circumstance** (1 review, 1 other source): A short Mind Left Body jam sits between Saint of Circumstance and Drums; Uploader lists a jam after Saint of Circumstance leading into Drums, with The Weight as encore [5][12]
- **Dear Prudence Jam** (2 reviews): Reviewer wonders whether the jam out of Saint of Circumstance is Dear Prudence or Mind Left Body; Reviewer loved the Dear Prudence Jam featuring Airto [14][16]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer praises Stella Blue as especially sweet, and also singles out a very good Ramble On Rose [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Dear Prudence Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-12-30.sbd.miller.32574.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 186 min; rated 2.67/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd1991-12-30.135052.dts.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 178 min [3]
- **gd1991-12-30.135051.mtx.tobin.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 178 min [4]
- **gd1991-12-30.fob.bk4011.buick-young.gems.105000.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 184 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the recording as sounding nice, with a punchy first set; Reviewer argues audience tapes like this are fine, though older ones often have muddy bass response [19][21]
- **gd1991-12-30.148758.FOB.Schoeps.Dalton-Miller-Noel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 22 songs; 183 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd91-12-30.b_ks.georges.6812.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 184 min; rated 2.17/5 by 6 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says no good soundboard circulates for this recording, which is an audience copy of the show; Reviewer calls this an audience copy of very poor quality, wishing a soundboard existed; Reviewer finds this source awful and wants a better one [12][13][14][15][17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says second set is rough around the edges, yet the whole show is potent [17]
- Airto joins the band from Saint of Circumstance through Space, and again for Stella Blue [19]
- Reviewer calls a little jam a gem, with Airto's percussion and vocals as the glue [20]
- Reviewer rates this show above New Year's Eve, though prefers the 12/28 show over all four [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-12-30.sbd.miller.32574.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD (Ultra-Matrix) -> Master Dat (44.1k) D [1]
- **gd1991-12-30.135052.dts.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: DTS-Audio-CD 5.1 Mix ; SBD (shnid=32574) SBD (Ultra-Matrix) -> Master Dat (44.1k) All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller + AUD (shn id 6812) FOB/DFC… [3]. Also: DTS surround mix made by an archive.org user, converted to FLAC on 18 January 2016 [3]
- **gd1991-12-30.135051.mtx.tobin.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid=32574) SBD (Ultra-Matrix) -> Master Dat (44.1k) All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller + AUD (shn id 6812) FOB/DFC hand… [4]. Also: Matrix mixing two sources, about 53% soundboard and 47% audience, made by an archive.org user [4]
- **gd1991-12-30.fob.bk4011.buick-young.gems.105000.flac16**: taped by Marcus Buick and James Young; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: B&K4011s > MIT Cable > Oade Power Supply > Panasonic sv255 Recording Location: FOB - Hand Held Both Sets [5]. Also: Same taping team also recorded the 28th; Litzenberger made an audience tape of New Year's Eve [21]
- **gd1991-12-30.148758.FOB.Schoeps.Dalton-Miller-Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: (FOB) Schoeps MK-4 > Oade Custom Pre Amp > Sony D3 > Master DAT (see notes) [6]. Also: No recording details came with the DAT; best guess is Schoeps microphones, matching Tim's 12/28 recording [6]
- **gd91-12-30.b_ks.georges.6812.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB/DFChand held/ORTF B&K 4011 > Neuman BS 48i-2 phantom power > Sony TCD D-10 Pro-2 (modified)DAT master > 1 clone played back through an Edirol UA-5,hardware… [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 30, 1991](https://www.dead.net/show/december-30-1991) [24]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 30, 1991](https://www.dead.net/show/december-30-1991) [25]
- Poster by Philip Andelman Grateful Dead: [1991-12-30 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1991-12-30-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [26]
